acceptanceCriteria: score.go reports cited-not-gold rate at path and span level alongside miss; a scripted cite-every-suggestion agent loses on that metric in a test.
A registration file format is specified and the report refuses a run whose registration commit is newer than its first lane (extends CRT-V0-010).

The treatment arm definition is the shipped profile's artifact, not the all-unknown cem/0.1 worklist; the spec records that any run before decision 0523 P2 has a baseline is invalid as outcome evidence.
body: Source: decision 0523 (docs/decisions/0523-cem-1-0-rc3-verifier-computed-support-2026-10-11.md) and build-log docs/build-log/2026-10-11-cem-1-0-expert-panel.md, origin/main fb11b2274. tools/cem-trial/score.go `scoreLane` computes `Miss` over meta.Gold only; a lane that cites every file reaches miss 0 at no cost and the seeded arm hands out up to 8 suggestions per file. select.go/gold.go record secondary span gold that no scorer reads. Decision 0523 P4. Expected: precision (cited-not-gold rate at path and span level) is scored, and a registration file committed before selection fixes hypotheses, primary metric, alpha, n, scorer sha256, model, effort and partition. Running the trial itself is post-rc.3 and owner-commissioned.
